en.headline: Man charged with murder over Heng Fa Chuen knife killing
en.dek: A 51-year-old man who surrendered after his 53-year-old wife was found dead with multiple stab wounds has been formally charged and appeared in court.
body: Police today charged a 51-year-old man with one count of murder in connection with the death of a 53-year-old woman at a flat in Heng Fa Chuen, Chai Wan.

The man surrendered himself at Kowloon City Police Station on Wednesday evening, telling officers he had attacked his wife with a kitchen knife earlier that day. Officers forced entry to the couple’s rented unit and found the woman dead on the master-bedroom bed with multiple knife wounds to the neck, waist and hands. She was certified dead at the scene.

Preliminary inquiries indicated the couple had argued over the man’s high-risk investments that left him more than HK$1 million in debt. The family has two sons still in education. The case was adjourned at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts and the defendant was remanded in custody.
Police said there was no prior record of domestic violence involving the household.

zh.headline: 杏花邨殺妻案 51歲男被控謀殺還押
zh.dek: 涉案男子周三晚到警署自首，承認以廚刀襲擊妻子，女事主倒斃單位內，今日被正式控以謀殺罪。
body: 警方今日（9月18日）暫控一名51歲男子一項謀殺罪，案件與周三在柴灣杏花邨發生的倫常命案有關，案中一名53歲女子死亡。
該名男子周三晚上約7時半到九龍城警署自首，表示較早前在杏花邨寓所以廚刀襲擊妻子。警方破門入屋後，發現女事主倒臥主人房牀上，頸、腰及手部有多處刀傷，當場證實不治。
初步調查顯示，男子近期進行高風險投資，欠債逾百萬元，夫婦曾因此爭拗，關係轉差。涉事家庭育有兩名仍在求學的兒子。案件今日在東區裁判法院提堂，被告被還押候訊。
警方表示，涉事家庭過去並無家庭暴力或糾紛紀錄。
